purpose: Persistent historical research commissioning and publication register. Check event_id, research scope and existing WordPress posts across all statuses before commissioning; do not treat a published anchor as completion of every empirical follow-up.
rules: Unique key per event and differentiated research question.
Published entries must match a WordPress article in data/year-review.json.
Entries associated with editorial commissions must match their exact commission record.
Never backdate actual WordPress publication dates.

entries.scope: Did India's GST rate reset reach consumer prices or only tax collections?
entries.remaining_evidence: Publish transaction-level matched-price and receipts data notebook; current article includes a simple illustrative scenario and research synthesis, not a causal estimate.

entries.scope: When forced-labour tariffs hit supply chains, who paid the compliance bill?
entries.remaining_evidence: Build a matched HS-level proposal-to-final tariff exposure table and compliance-cost estimates.

entries.scope: The tariff announcement is not the factory-gate price
entries.remaining_evidence: Track any subsequent TRQ implementation, actual covered customs-line imports and exemptions; do not assume quota activation.

entries.scope: What India's revised GDP series changes about the investment story
entries.remaining_evidence: Create a reproducible cross-vintage workbook from MoSPI release tables and test how the extra release-calendar time affects later revision sizes.

entries.scope: Labour rules are not labour rights until they operate in the workplace
entries.remaining_evidence: Publish a true clause-by-clause comparison of the draft and final Central Rules and a jurisdiction-appropriate state implementation tracker with enforcement outcomes.

entries.scope: Where the Economic Survey's investment case can be tested
entries.remaining_evidence: Keep a vintage-consistent FY26 budget-to-outturn dataset and add project commissioning and private investment evidence; a fiscal shortfall is not proof of project failure.

entries.scope: A rate hold is not a pause in interest-rate transmission
entries.remaining_evidence: Extend matched monthly rates across loan categories and update the source-coded dataset with revised vintages; the article establishes the historical checkpoint, not a causal estimate.
